text: I've been trying to get through for nearly an hour now. My granddaughter is 11. She's come out in a rash, little dark red dots and a couple of bigger purple marks, and I did the glass test and they don't fade, you can still see them plain as day. She's also complaining the light hurts her eyes, she's got her arm over her face and wants the big light off. Her neck isn't stiff, she can put her chin down on her chest fine, I checked. And she's been to the toilet and weeing like normal. I'd like someone to actually tell me what to do please.
